name: Anterior Interosseous Nerve Syndrome
category: Neurology/Orthopedics > Peripheral Nerve > Median Motor Branch
definition: Motor neuropathy affecting the anterior interosseous branch of the median nerve, producing weakness of FPL, FDP to index and pronator quadratus without cutaneous sensory loss.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics and imaging are selected according to localization and suspected cause.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent deficit or compressive lesion may need specialist decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Motor neuropathy affecting the anterior interosseous branch of the median nerve, producing weakness of FPL, FDP to index and pronator quadratus without cutaneous sensory loss.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
